analysis.narrativeEn:

· MACD histogram trajectory (63.4319→63.4319) + maintaining strength + no trend reversal signal.

· Swing support ($2,401.18) + basis (Bollinger Middle Band and Pivot S1).
· Swing resistance ($2,462.8) + potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low recovery initiation) + sustained uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.55x) + increased confidence in the move.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + buy entry conditions met.
